proficiency.desc: Proficiency = 2 + floor((level - 1) / 8): +2 at level 1, +8 at level 49.

skill_bonus.desc: Rank 0 = 0 (untrained). Rank r >= 1 = proficiency + (r - 1). Trait and item modifiers add on top.

creation.desc: Every stat starts at 8. Spend 20 points: 1 each up to 13, 2 each for 14-15, 3 each for 16-17. Race modifiers apply after.

stat_raise.desc: After creation a +1 costs 1 CP below 14, 2 CP from 14 to 17, 3 CP for 18 and 19. Natural cap 20; items and effects can go higher.

tiers.desc: Buying tier t of a discipline costs 1 CP and needs: tier t-1, the level, the discipline's key stat and its governing skill rank shown here. Tiers 4 and 5 of Arcane disciplines need aptitude >= 25 / 50, Gear disciplines <= -25 / -50. Neutral disciplines have no aptitude gate.

aptitude.desc: aptitude = race base + round(100 * (A - G) / (A + G + N + 5)), where A, G and N are the weighted points spent in Arcane, Gear and Neutral skill ranks (x1) and discipline tiers (x2). Plus 'aptitude' modifiers. Clamped to -100..100.

hp.desc: Max HP = race hp_base + CON score + (level - 1) * max(1, race hp_per_level + CON mod), times the grade's hp multiplier, plus hp_max modifiers.

ac.desc: AC = 10 + DEX mod + floor(Dodge rank / 2) + natural_ac + armour + ac modifiers.

ap.desc: 6 AP per round, plus ap_max modifiers (minimum 1).
